description:
As a platform engineer, you are tasked with simulating a simple CI/CD data pipeline that processes input data from a CSV file, handles possible errors during the pipeline, and logs both successes and error recoveries. Here are the steps you need to perform: 1. Go to the directory /home/user/pipeline where your pipeline work is stored. 2. The file /home/user/pipeline/input.csv contains data where each line consists of two comma-separated fields: a username and an email address. Some lines may have missing fields or incorrect formatting that you should treat as errors. 3. Your task is to process each line in input.csv and produce two outputs: - Write properly formatted lines (with exactly one username and one valid-looking email containing '@') to /home/user/pipeline/output.csv, with the same format as input.csv. - Log every encountered error to /home/user/pipeline/pipeline.log. Each error log entry should be a single line in the following format:
[ERROR] Line X: <original_line> - <error_description>
where X is the line number (starting at 1 for the first line), <original_line> is the text of the faulty line, and <error_description> is either "Missing fields" or "Invalid email". - If an error is encountered, recover by skipping that line. Successful recoveries must also be logged. For each recovery, after logging the error, log another line:
[RECOVERY] Line X: Skipped erroneous data. - For successfully processed lines, log:
[SUCCESS] Line X: <original_line> 4. At the end, output.csv should only contain valid entries, and pipeline.log should precisely record all processing outcomes in the formats above, with no extra information. Ensure the pipeline.log is plain text and strictly follows the templates for error, recovery, and success, with entries in the order that lines are processed. Do not modify input.csv. Show the contents of both output.csv and pipeline.log to verify completion.

The agent must produce these files:

File /home/user/pipeline/output.csv after completion:

File /home/user/pipeline/pipeline.log after completion:
[SUCCESS] Line 1: alice,alice@example.com
[ERROR] Line 2: bob, - Missing fields
[RECOVERY] Line 2: Skipped erroneous data.
[ERROR] Line 3: charlie,charlie_at_example.com - Invalid email
[RECOVERY] Line 3: Skipped erroneous data.
[SUCCESS] Line 4: dan,dan@example.org
